cwe_name: Exposure of Resource to Wrong Sphere

connection.evidence: updated_doc flows from external source through markdown rendering to innerHTML assignment, but this is data transformation, not resource access

diff_causality.evidence: The patch adds HTML rendering functionality, but doesn't demonstrate resource exposure across trust boundaries

concrete_impact.evidence: No demonstrated resource exposure; potential HTML injection but not CWE-668 mechanism
